proposal.reason: Main change is logical channel/ring graph correctness in graph construction and post-processing, so graph-search is primary: src/graph/connect.cc adds per-algorithm channelMap initialization/copying, fixes compCap80/89 shuffle behavior, restores odd-node ring reversal in ncclTopoPostset, and updates connectRings endpoint assignment; src/include/graph.h adds channelMap and ringReverse fields that support this graph behavior. Secondary network review is needed for an independent proxy-selection contract fix: src/graph/search.cc (ncclTopoGetNetDev) now reuses cached proxyDevs only when send-rank/NIC match and otherwise resolves intermediate proxy rank, changing NIC/proxy selection semantics.
